symbols.name: chunk width
symbols.meaning: The number of address bits in one chunk.
symbols.quote: Chunks are $K$ address bits wide, where $K$ is the number of bits in one chunk.

relations.quote: Transform layout is reached by swapping contiguous chunks, as in [Address-field interchange](address-interchange.md).
The layout lays out the rounds of [Synthetic polynomial transforms](synthetic-transforms.md) on tape, one layer per round.
It feeds the [Simultaneous butterfly layer](simultaneous-butterfly-layer.md) its bits in this form.
